title: Derivative of a quantile conditional integral
statement: Let $\gamma$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R$, let $\Phi$ be its distribution function, and let $Q$ be the total Gaussian quantile. For $\rho,t,d,a\in\mathbb R$ with $a\in(0,1)$, the function $p\mapsto\int_{(-\infty,Q(p)]}\Phi\bigl((t-\rho x)/d\bigr)\,d\gamma(x)$ is differentiable at $a$, with derivative $\Phi\bigl((t-\rho Q(a))/d\bigr)$.
